evals.prompt: I have a UserService class with these methods: register(), login(), logout(), resetPassword(), updateProfile(), getProfilePicture(), uploadProfilePicture(), resizeImage(), sendWelcomeEmail(), sendPasswordResetEmail(), validateEmailFormat(), validatePasswordStrength(), hashPassword(), generateToken(), verifyToken(). Is this a SOLID violation? What should I do?
evals.expected_output: The skill should identify this as a Single Responsibility Principle violation (the class does authentication, profile management, image processing, email delivery, validation, and token management — at least 6 distinct responsibilities). Should propose splitting into: AuthService (login/logout/token), RegistrationService (register/welcome email), ProfileService (update/photo), ImageService (resize), EmailService (send), PasswordService (hash/validate/reset). Should also note this may be an Interface Segregation violation if the class implements a single interface. Should name the refactoring path: Extract Class for each responsibility.
